solution_steps: Use The Shallow Grave to summon Gravekeeper's Spy from your Graveyard.
Activate Book of Taiyou to flip Gravekeeper's Spy and Summon Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier from your deck.
Activate Nobleman of Crossout to remove Giant Axe Mummy.
Kill Don Zaloog with Mystic Tomato. The Summoning effect will grant you Gravekeeper's Cannonholder.
Attack the face-down Slate Warrior with Spear Soldier, and attack directly twice.
Tribute the other Gravekeeper's monsters for Cannonholder's effect.
